Businessman shot more than 20 times in his store

By Staff Reporter 17 October 2026

A shop owner was shot dead inside his store in an extension of the border town on Friday 16 October, police said.

Witnesses told police that two armed men entered the shop shortly after it opened and fired repeatedly before fleeing on foot.

Police have opened a murder case and appealed to anyone with information to come forward. No arrests have been made.
